description: Return the opaque id of the profile behind this request's authenticated credentials, or no id when the caller has no profile. That id is the only profile value this tool exposes: it is unique within this app, stays unchanged across token refresh, reconnection, and display-metadata changes, and is never reassigned to another profile. Use it to decide whether a profile exists before scoring a contract. No name, email, or other identifiers are read or returned. Limits follow the caller's key plan, the same as search_contracts. Read-only.
name: get_profile
